entity.name: Mrinal Singh Meena
entity.description: Lawyer turned builder from Jaipur, India. I build public instruments that hold themselves to a courtroom standard of evidence. Seiche is the main one: free early warning for dollar funding stress, with every forecast sealed into a hash chained ledger the day it is made, misses published next to the hits.

projects.name: Seiche
projects.description: A free public terminal that monitors stress building in dollar funding and repo markets. The current 64-module engine suite turns public FRED, New York Fed, OFR, Treasury FiscalData, CFTC, ECB and EIA inputs into a static board snapshot every four hours and one daily letter. Forward publications enter a tamper-evident as-published record. Historical diagnostics publish their verdicts and misses but are final/current-vintage construction-PIT, not validated backtests. The complete backend suite gates publication. The terminal, Time Machine and dispatch archive are free and stay free.
